fact: The Council of Ministers discussed the draft Cybersecurity Law, the draft Data and Artificial Intelligence Law and the draft Digital Transformation Law of 2026 and directed further study before approval in a joint session of the Council of Ministers and the Sovereign Council.
title: مجلس الوزراء يستعرض تقريري الوضع الاقتصادي الراهن والإمداد الكهربائي بالبلاد
